gloss_en: Verse quote (Ps. 58:11) 'The righteous shall rejoice when he sees vengeance' — cited in Likutey Moharan II:4 for the joy of the tzaddik/Israel when the revelation of the Divine Will (through the festival's call and charity) shows that God, not nature, governs, and He will avenge the oppressions of the nations
canonical_he: ישמח צדיק כי חזה נקם וכו'
